_rule: ARC-09-S09. An extension listed here is tracked but has NO explicit rule in .gitattributes and is deliberately left to `* text=auto eol=lf`. A reason per entry, because 'it was already like that' is how a policy file stops meaning anything. An entry is not permission to commit CRLF: `text=auto` still normalises the index to LF, and tests/eol.test.mjs still asserts it.

extensions..js: the committed dist/ and the docs-spike fixtures; covered by `packages/snowarch/dist/** text eol=lf` where it matters, and by text=auto elsewhere
extensions..map: source maps beside the committed dist/; generated, never hand-edited
extensions..ts: the server package's sources; text=auto normalises them and no tool needs CRLF
extensions..yml: GitHub workflows; the runner reads them on Linux and Windows alike
extensions..toml: one config file; no platform reads it in a line-ending-sensitive way
extensions..py: scripts/md-to-docx.py — a shebang script, so LF is the requirement text=auto already gives it
